headline: Oil prices have dropped precipitously
dek: The President says oil prices dropped precipitously after the midterm elections, as he predicted, and calls the whole thing a Giant Hoax. Meanwhile, at a real American kitchen table…

original.speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Isn’t it interesting that Oil prices have dropped precipitously after the Midterm Elections? I said that was going to happen. The whole thing is a Giant Hoax! President DONALD J. TRUMP
original.key: Isn’t it interesting that Oil prices have dropped precipitously after the Midterm Elections?
original.context: Posted on 22 November 2026. The account of oil prices is the President’s. Steve is a fictional character.

verification.note: Copied by the editor from truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump on 23 November 2026 (shown as 11/22/26, 1:49 PM Pacific).

meanwhile.hook: Trump says oil prices dropped precipitously. *Meanwhile, at Steve’s house…*
steve: I just filled up. Still sixty-three cents a gallon more than last year.
*The only thing that dropped precipitously is my bank balance.*

fact.text: a gallon of regular gas, national average on November 19, 2026, against $3.09 a year earlier.

meanwhile.ticker: Gas: $3.72 a gallon, still 63 cents more than a year ago (AAA, November 19, 2026)
